name: EfficientLLM
description: EfficientLLM is a large-scale empirical benchmark that systematically quantifies efficiency–performance trade-offs across the entire lifecycle of large language models, including pretraining, fine-tuning, and quantization. It evaluates multiple orthogonal efficiency dimensions such as memory, throughput, energy, and compression across diverse hardware setups and model scales.
typical_sota_score: varies by metric; no single composite SOTA (depends on throughput/memory/energy trade-off)
reputation: Widely cited as a new efficiency-focused benchmark for LLM lifecycle trade-off analysis, but still early in community adoption.
notes: Evaluates efficiency-performance trade-offs across multiple hardware and lifecycle stages; includes over 150 model-technique pairs from 0.5B to 72B parameters.
